html:
Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany, on the river Spree in the north east of the country. It grew from a pair of medieval trading towns into the capital of Prussia, of the German Empire and of today's Germany.

Berlin and its twin town Cölln are first recorded in the 1230s and 1240s. From the 1400s the Hohenzollern rulers of Brandenburg made it their seat, and in 1701 it became the capital of the Kingdom of Prussia. French Protestant refugees arrived after 1685, and Frederick the Great built it up in the 1700s.

When Germany was united in 1871, Berlin became the imperial capital. It hosted the Congress of Berlin in 1878 and the Berlin Conference on Africa in 1884 and 1885. Firms such as Siemens made it a great industrial city, and in the 1920s it was a centre of art, science and nightlife.

It was the capital of Nazi Germany and was largely destroyed in 1945. The four victors split it into sectors. The Soviets blockaded the western sectors in 1948 and 1949, and from 1961 the Berlin Wall cut West Berlin off from East Germany, whose capital was East Berlin. The fall of the Wall in 1989 led to reunification, and Berlin again became the seat of the German government.
sum: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany, on the river Spree in the north east of the country. It grew from a pair of medieval trading towns into the capital of Prussia, of the German Empire and of today's Germany.
